representation.hand_direction: native ANGLE_SET/ANGLE_ACT register convention; no additional inversion
representation.action_semantics: first accepted controller TCP reference and acknowledged hand target in [t,t+1/sample_hz)
representation.arm_target_stage: controller input after controller-specific equilibrium limiting, before realtime smoothing
representation.observation_semantics: latest received sample at or before t; no future observations

storage.deletion: atomic rename to dataset/.trash; no permanent delete command
